task_completion.description: Select 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' from the data source options in the System Control Panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' button or dropdown item is highlighted or selected within the OpenBCI GUI System Control Panel.

task_completion.description: Click the 'START SESSION' button to initialize the synthetic data stream.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'START SESSION' button is clicked, and the GUI transitions from the setup screen to the main dashboard.

task_completion.description: Click the 'Start Data Stream' button (usually top left) to begin the live visualization.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Data Stream' button changes state (e.g., turns from orange to blue or changes text to 'Stop Data Stream').

task_completion.description: Confirm the GUI indicates it is in Synthetic mode.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The top status bar or control panel displays 'SYNTHETIC' or 'Synthetic (Algorithmic)' as the active source.

task_completion.description: Ensure the Time Series widget shows active, moving EEG waveforms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Time Series widget displays 8 or 16 channels of scrolling, oscillating waveforms (synthetic EEG) rather than flat lines.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OpenBCI GUI elements rather than using terminal commands to bypass the interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements and clicks are visible on the GUI buttons (Synthetic, Start Session) in the trajectory screenshots.

integrity.description: The data stream is live and not a static image or pre-recorded video playback.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps or x-axis of the Time Series widget progress across sequential screenshots.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a pre-saved configuration file to skip the manual selection of Synthetic mode.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the manual selection of 'SYNTHETIC' in the System Control Panel.

privileged_info_for_vlm: OpenBCI GUI v5.2.2 requires selecting 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' in the System Control Panel before clicking 'START SESSION'. Once the session starts, the user must click 'Start Data Stream' (top left) to see live waveforms. In Synthetic mode, the Time Series widget should show 8 channels of algorithmically generated EEG data (clean sine-like or rhythmic waves).
